clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs edit the same timeout/progress-reset block in protocol.ts. #2763 ships a .changeset entry (matching the repo convention also followed by #2678) and its description explicitly states the fix covers both the no-progress case ('pending timer now arms for whichever limit comes first') and the progress-reset case ('progress resets re-arm against the remaining budget'), i.e. it already addresses the scenario #2817 targets. #2817 has no changeset file and its one-line change (stamping info.startTime = Date.now() on every progress reset) resets the elapsed-time baseline used for the maxTotalTimeout cap, which works against enforcing that cap when progress notifications keep arriving — the opposite of the guarantee #2763 adds. #2763 is the more complete, better-documented fix for this code path.
